With a Little Help From Hitmonchan (Japanese: VS エビワラー VS Hitmonchan), titled VS Hitmonchan in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 450th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the ninth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Gathering of the Four Executives! (Japanese: 集合４将軍！ The Four Generals Assemble!) in the VIZ Media translation and The Four Executives Together in the Chuang Yi translation.
plainText:
With a Little Help From Hitmonchan (Japanese: VS エビワラー VS Hitmonchan), titled VS Hitmonchan in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 450th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the ninth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Gathering of the Four Executives! (Japanese: 集合４将軍！ The Four Generals Assemble!) in the VIZ Media translation and The Four Executives Together in the Chuang Yi translation.

==Plot==
 
 continues her battle against Ariana. When Ariana's into the air, Crystal's Monlee manages to strike it with a . Ariana says that Crystal is so desperate because had left the battle, but Crystal strongly denies it. Ariana's defeats Crystal's Bonee, and her Murkrow takes down Monlee. Then, Ariana reveals the roles of the four Team Rocket s: Ariana eradicates obstacles that get in their way, Petrel sneaks into various locations in disguise to find the Plates, Proton has to locate the Sinjoh Ruins by using critical thinking, and Archer is the group's leader in obtaining .

Upon saying this, Petrel, Proton, and Archer arrive on the scene. Archer reveals that Arceus is already summoned, and points to it. Crystal looks at it, shaking in terror. Archer says it was found in a far-off land at the end of a long road, but thinks they would not believe the place's name or where it exists, so he decides to not say them. More importantly, Arceus has come down to the world because all of the Plates are gathered in Johto.

However, Crystal feels as if Arceus is different from the other and Mythical Pokémon she has met because of how intense Arceus seems to be. Based on what Archer said about where Arceus came from, she concludes that Arceus doesn't belong to anyone yet. She then kicks a Level Ball at Arceus.
